title: What is an ETF?
excerpt: A simple explanation of one of the most widely used investment structures.
body: An exchange-traded fund is an investment fund whose shares trade on an exchange. Many ETFs hold a basket of assets designed to track an index or market segment.
Diversification can reduce dependence on a single company, while fees and tracking differences still matter over time.
An ETF is a structure, not a guarantee of safety. Its risk ultimately depends on the assets it owns and the strategy it follows.
